name: shiftregister
title: shiftregister
notes: Described from its headers and code, not tried.

init.notes: shiftregister_config_t: the GPIOs of data, clock and latch, of SRCLR and OE, and SHIFTREGISTER_MODE_WRITE. The config goes to every call; there is no handle.

write.notes: Bytes LSB first, the first byte to the register farthest from the chip; the latch pulses after each byte.

hc595.notes: Bit-banged on GPIOs, no SPI. It takes GPIO 0 for an unused SRCLR or OE and sets neither: wire SRCLR high and OE low. Its example gives GPIO_NUM_NC there, which its code shifts by -1.

api.source: include/ and shiftregister_gpio.c of esp-idf-lib/shiftregister at tag 1.0.2, commit 3d69b7f

1.0.2.notes: Its manifest names no ESP-IDF; the CI of esp-idf-lib built its example with v5.4 to v6.1.
